summary: __init__ sets up a new object's fields. Default parameter values let one __init__ handle several ways of creating an object.
notes: name="New student" is used only when the caller leaves name out.
scores=None with an if check gives every Student a fresh empty list.
Student("Sam", scores=[70]) uses a keyword argument to skip grade_level.
pitfall: Writing scores=[] as the default makes every Student share one list, so appending a score to one student shows up for all of them.
